problemStatement.formal: For odd primes p ≠ q: legendreSym p q * legendreSym q p = (-1)^((p-1)/2 * (q-1)/2). First supplement: legendreSym p (-1) = (-1)^((p-1)/2). Second supplement: legendreSym p 2 = (-1)^((p²-1)/8).
problemStatement.plain: Formalize elementary proofs of quadratic reciprocity via Gauss's lemma, Eisenstein's lattice point counting, and the Eisenstein proof chain. Include first and second supplements.
whyMatters: Quadratic reciprocity is Gauss's 'golden theorem' - one of the most important in number theory
The Eisenstein lattice point proof is a beautiful geometric argument
Connects Legendre symbols to lattice point counting via Gauss sums
